events.name: Green Monday
events.desc: Clean Monday marks the start of Lent. Families head to the countryside for picnics and kite flying. A public holiday.
events.sourceName: Central Bank of Cyprus: bank holidays 2027

events.name: Orthodox Easter
events.desc: The biggest celebration of the Cypriot year: Good Friday processions, the midnight Resurrection service with bonfires, then Easter Sunday feasts. Easter Sunday is 2 May.
events.sourceName: Central Bank of Cyprus: bank holidays 2027

events.name: Kataklysmos, the Festival of the Flood
events.desc: Pentecost Monday, celebrated by the sea. Larnaca's seafront usually hosts the biggest festivities, with water games, music and stalls around the holiday.
events.sourceName: Central Bank of Cyprus: bank holidays 2027
